verdict.rationale: Buzz is self-hostable: you can run your own relay on a single node or VPS, or install the first-party Helm chart, which can point at your own external Postgres, Redis and S3-compatible storage. That lets a user decide where their data physically lives ("that place is yours"). It is not an explicit residency feature, though: nothing documents region selection for operator-hosted instances or makes any data-residency guarantee. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for hosted workspaces, explicit data-residency documentation, independent corroboration of self-hosted residency control.
